proposal.before: He opened ironworks on Mount Shang and salt monopolies at Wuchang Marsh to swell the army's coffers.
proposal.after: He established smelting works on Mount Shang and a salt office at Wuchang Marsh to increase resources for the army and the state.
proposal.reason: The source specifies smelting and a salt administration for military and state use, but not iron, monopolies, or army coffers.

context.zh: 謨曆對詳辯，畫地成圖。
context.idiomatic: Yan Mo answered in fluent detail and sketched a map in the dust.
context.literal: Yan Mo answered in sequence, detailed and disputatious, and drew lines on the ground to make a map.

context.zh: 德深嘉之，拜尚書郎。
context.idiomatic: Murong De was so impressed he named him a gentleman of the Masters of Writing.
context.literal: De deeply praised him and appointed him gentleman of the masters of writing.

context.zh: 立冶于商山，置鹽官于烏常澤，以廣軍國之用。
context.idiomatic: He opened ironworks on Mount Shang and salt monopolies at Wuchang Marsh to swell the army's coffers.
context.literal: He set up smelting works on Mount Shang and salt offices at Wuchang Marsh to broaden military and state use.

context.zh: 德故吏趙融自長安來，始具母兄凶問，德號慟吐血，因而寢疾。
context.idiomatic: His old clerk Zhao Rong arrived from Chang'an with word of his mother and brother's deaths; Murong De howled until he coughed blood and fell gravely ill.
context.literal: De's former clerk Zhao Rong came from Chang'an and first brought full news of the mourning for mother and elder brother; De wailed and spat blood, and on that account took to bed ill.

context.zh: 其司隸校尉慕容達因此謀反，遣牙門皇璆率眾攻端門，殿中師侯赤眉開門應之。
context.idiomatic: Metropolitan commandant Murong Da seized the moment to rebel, sent Huang Kui against the Duan Gate, and won inside help from Hou Chimei.
context.literal: His metropolitan commandant Murong Da thereupon plotted rebellion, sent gate guard Huang Kui to lead a host attacking the Duan Gate, and palace instructor Hou Chimei opened the gate in response.

proposal.before: Palace attendant Xun Jin helped De over the wall and hid him in a forward lodging.
proposal.after: Palace attendant Xun Jin helped De over the wall, and De hid at Jin's residence.
proposal.reason: 遜進 is the personal name Xun Jin; 進舍 is his residence. The subject of the second clause is rendered as De, without inventing Xun Jin as the agent of hiding.

proposal.before: Spanning several thousand li, hosts exceeding a hundred thousand, we could west merge with strong Qin and north resist Great Wei.
proposal.after: Spanning several thousand li with a host exceeding a hundred thousand, we could annex strong Qin to the west and resist Great Wei to the north.
proposal.reason: 西並強秦 describes annexing Qin, not merging with it by agreement.

context.zh: 且江、淮南北戶口未幾，公私戎馬不過數百，守備之事蓋亦微矣。
context.idiomatic: Moreover north and south of the Yangzi and Huai households are still few; public and private war horses number only in the hundreds; matters of defense are also slight.
context.literal: Moreover north and south of the Yangzi and Huai households are still few; public and private war horses number only in the hundreds; matters of defense are also slight.

context.zh: 若以步騎一萬，建雷霆之舉，卷甲長驅，指臨江、會，必望旗草偃，壺漿屬路。
context.idiomatic: If with ten thousand foot and horse we raise a thunderstroke, roll armor in a long drive, point to Linjiang and Kuaiji, they are sure to lower banners like grass bending, and jars of broth will line the road.

context.zh: 跨地數千，眾逾十萬，可以西並強秦，北抗大魏。

context.literal: Spanning several thousand li, hosts exceeding a hundred thousand, we could west merge with strong Qin and north resist Great Wei.

context.zh: 夫欲拓境開疆，保寧社稷，無過今也。
context.idiomatic: For desiring to widen territory and open frontiers, guarding altars of soil and grain, nothing surpasses now.
context.literal: For desiring to widen territory and open frontiers, guarding altars of soil and grain, nothing surpasses now.

context.zh: 如使後機失會，豪桀復起，梟除桓玄，布惟新之化，遐邇既寧，物無異望，非但建鄴難屠，江北亦不可冀。

proposal.reason: Restore the reported troop and vehicle figures and visual and sound details; these are the text’s figures, not an independently verified count. Vehicles avoids deciding the exact type of 車.

context.zh: 今者之事，王公其詳議之。」

context.zh: 咸以桓玄新得志，未可圖，乃止。
context.idiomatic: The court judged Huan Xuan too strong for the moment and dropped the idea.
context.literal: All thought Huan Xuan newly triumphant and not yet to be plotted against, and therefore stopped.

context.zh: 於是講武於城西，步兵三十七萬，車一萬七千乘，鐵騎五萬三千，周亙山澤，旌旗彌漫，鉦鼓之聲，振動天地。
context.idiomatic: He staged a review west of the city with hundreds of thousands on parade.
context.literal: Thereupon he drilled troops west of the city: three hundred seventy thousand foot, seventeen thousand carts, fifty-three thousand armored horse, filling mountains and marshes, banners covering heaven, the clash of gongs and drums shaking heaven and earth.

context.zh: 德登高望之，顧謂劉軌、高雅之曰：「昔郤克仇齊，子胥怨楚，終能暢其剛烈，名流千載。
context.idiomatic: De climbed high and looked over them, and said to Liu Gui and Gao Yazhi, 'Formerly Xi Ke avenged Qi, Wu Zixu resented Chu, and in the end they could vent their fierce integrity and their names flow a thousand years.
context.literal: De climbed high and looked over them, and said to Liu Gui and Gao Yazhi, 'Formerly Xi Ke avenged Qi, Wu Zixu resented Chu, and in the end they could vent their fierce integrity and their names flow a thousand years.

context.zh: 卿等既知投身有道，當使無慚昔人也。」
context.idiomatic: You gentlemen already know to cast yourselves onto a rightful way; you should make yourselves not ashamed before the ancients.'
context.literal: You gentlemen already know to cast yourselves onto a rightful way; you should make yourselves not ashamed before the ancients.'

context.idiomatic: Soon they heard Huan Xuan was defeated; Murong De made Murong Zhen the vanguard and Murong Zhong supreme commander, assigning twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse with a set departure date, but Murong De fell ill and therefore halted the army.
context.literal: Soon they heard Huan Xuan was defeated; De made Murong Zhen vanguard and Murong Zhong supreme commander, pairing them with twenty thousand foot and five thousand horse, fixing a date to set out, but De took to bed ill, and therefore the army was halted.

context.zh: 初，德迎其兄子超于長安，及是而至。
context.idiomatic: Murong Chao, whom he had summoned from Chang'an, now arrived.
context.literal: Earlier, De had welcomed his brother's son Chao from Chang'an; at this point he arrived.

context.zh: 德夜夢其父曰：「汝既無子，何不早立超為太子，不爾，惡人生心。」
